create_SetOfTensors: create a SetOfTensors instance from an iterable of PyTorch tensors to deduplicate them
iterate_SetOfTensors: iterate over a SetOfTensors to retrieve each unique tensor as a PyTorch tensor
check_contains_SetOfTensors: check if a PyTorch tensor or numeric value exists in a SetOfTensors instance
len_SetOfTensors: get the count of unique tensors stored in a SetOfTensors instance
str_SetOfTensors: get a sorted string representation of all tensors in a SetOfTensors instance
